_comment: MAHADASHA cluster illustration plan (2026-06-09 batch). Hero = 1 diffusion image per article (gemini-web, no text). Inline = LLM-planned SVG infographics, bilingual EN+ZH. Year/duration numbers verified against article text by the planning layer.

hero.prompt: An atmospheric editorial night sky in deep indigo fading to near-black, nine softly glowing planetary orbs of warm gold light arranged along a slow sweeping arc like beads on an unseen thread, the largest low and bright and the smallest high and faint, faint concentric orbital rings suggesting a vast cycle of time, contemplative and cinematic, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: Nine glowing planetary lights strung along a slow arc across a deep indigo night sky, evoking a long cycle of time.
hero.altZh: 九颗金色行星之光沿着缓缓展开的弧线排列在深靛蓝夜空中，象征一段漫长循环的时间。

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## The Nine Mahadasha Periods: Quick Guide
inline.titleEn: The Vimshottari Order: Nine Periods, 120 Years
inline.titleZh: Vimshottari 顺序：九段大运，共 120 年
inline.altEn: The nine mahadasha periods in their fixed Vimshottari order with each planet's year-span, from Ketu's 7 years through Mercury's 17, totaling 120 years.
inline.altZh: 九段行星大运按固定的 Vimshottari 顺序排列，标注每颗行星的年限，从计都 7 年到水星 17 年，合计 120 年。

hero.prompt: An atmospheric editorial scene of a partial lunar eclipse over a deep indigo near-black sky, a darkened moon rimmed with a hungry corona of gold light, faint streaks of restless cloud reaching outward, a sense of shadow and amplified longing, cinematic and contemplative, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: A shadowed moon ringed with gold light against a deep indigo sky, evoking the amplifying, restless tone of the Rahu period.
hero.altZh: 深靛蓝夜空中，一轮被阴影笼罩、边缘镶着金光的月亮，象征罗睺大运放大欲望与不安的基调。

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## Rahu Mahadasha vs Adjacent Concepts: How It Works + Trade-offs
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## Rahu Mahadasha 与相近概念：运作方式 + 取舍
inline.titleEn: Two Ends of the Node Axis

linesEn: Pushes outward: ambition, acquisition, the unfamiliar
Gains reach and speed, at the cost of grounding
linesZh: 向外推：野心、获取、陌生新奇
换来进取与速度，代价是难以安定

linesEn: Pulls inward: detachment, release, inner search
Its 7 years steady you, at the cost of outward drive
linesZh: 向内收：出离、放下、向内探寻
七年给你安定，代价是向外的冲劲

inline.altEn: A two-column contrast of Rahu pushing outward toward ambition versus Ketu pulling inward toward release, the two ends of the lunar-node axis.
inline.altZh: 两栏对照：罗睺向外推动野心，计都向内收回放下，是月亮交点轴的两端。

hero.prompt: An atmospheric editorial scene of thin gold smoke and dissolving mist drifting upward and thinning to nothing against a deep indigo near-black sky, a faint distant star, a quiet sense of things being gently released and let go, contemplative and still, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: Thin gold smoke dissolving into a deep indigo sky, evoking the Ketu period's themes of release and quiet inward turning.
hero.altZh: 缕缕金色轻烟在深靛蓝夜空中消散，象征计都大运放下与向内收束的主题。

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## Ketu Mahadasha vs Adjacent Concepts: How It Works + Trade-offs
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## Ketu Mahadasha 与相近概念：运作方式 + 取舍
inline.titleEn: Two Ends of the Node Axis

linesEn: Subtractive: strips over-identification, turns attention inward
7 years that bring clarity, at the cost of familiar comforts
linesZh: 做减法：剥落过度执着，把注意力收回向内
七年带来清明，代价是放掉熟悉的依恋

linesEn: Additive: pushes toward desire, accumulation, the worldly
18 years that expand reach, at the cost of inner steadiness
linesZh: 做加法：推向欲望、积累与世俗
十八年拓宽进取，代价是内在的安定

inline.altEn: A two-column contrast of Ketu's subtractive inward release versus Rahu's additive outward desire, the opposite ends of the same lunar-node axis.
inline.altZh: 两栏对照：计都做减法向内放下，罗睺做加法向外渴求，是同一根月亮交点轴的两端。

hero.prompt: An atmospheric editorial scene of a single weathered standing stone under a deep indigo near-black night sky, a slow trail of gold starlight arcing overhead like a long exposure marking the passage of years, patient and grave, a sense of time and earned endurance, contemplative and cinematic, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: A weathered standing stone beneath a long arc of gold starlight in a deep indigo sky, evoking the Saturn period's slow, earned passage of time.
hero.altZh: 深靛蓝夜空下一块风化的立石，头顶划过一道金色星轨，象征土星大运缓慢而踏实积累的时间感。

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Saturn (Shani) Mahadasha in Your Timing
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## 如何在自己星盘里识别 Saturn (Shani) Mahadasha
inline.titleZh: 十九年：踏实积累的长弧

items.noteEn: Often feels like added responsibility and slow starts before it settles.
items.noteZh: 常表现为责任加重、迟迟卡住，事情慢热难推。

items.noteEn: The sub-period inside the dasha changes the tone every few years.
items.noteZh: 大运里的小运每隔几年改变体感，并非一成不变。

items.noteEn: Returns earned structure late: what you built through steady work compounds.
items.noteZh: 回报来得晚：靠踏实努力搭起的根基逐渐累积成形。

inline.altEn: A three-stage timeline of the 19-year Saturn period: early delay and weight, mid-period antardasha shifts, and late consolidation of earned structure.
inline.altZh: 土星十九年的三段时间轴：前段延迟负重，中段小运轮转，后段结构成形、回报渐显。

hero.prompt: An atmospheric editorial scene of the bright planet Venus glowing low and warm gold over a tranquil deep-indigo twilight horizon, its light reflected softly on still water, a serene sense of beauty, harmony and gentle abundance, contemplative and cinematic, no text or letters.
hero.altEn: Venus glowing warm gold low over a calm indigo twilight horizon reflected on still water, evoking the Venus period's themes of beauty and ease.
hero.altZh: 金星泛着温暖金光低悬在靛蓝暮色地平线上，倒映于静水，象征金星大运关于美感与安适的主题。

inline.afterHeadingZh: ## 为什么了解它能帮助自我觉察
inline.titleEn: Three Areas Venus's Period Leans Toward
inline.titleZh: 金星大运倾向的三个领域

linesEn: Whether nourishing or strained depends on Venus's condition
linesZh: 伴侣、婚姻、重新靠近浮上来
滋养还是紧张，取决于金星的状态

linesEn: Gains tied to beauty, art, luxury, pleasant living
An afflicted Venus can tip toward overspending instead
linesZh: 与美、艺术、奢享、安适相关的收益
金星受克时反而可能偏向过度消费

linesEn: Music, design and craft finally get room to breathe
A lean, not a guarantee — it rewards attention
linesZh: 音乐、设计与手艺终于有了空间
是倾向而非承诺——它回报用心的人

inline.altEn: A three-column view of the life areas Venus's twenty-year period leans toward: relationships, finances and material life, and creativity, each a tendency rather than a promise.
inline.altZh: 三栏呈现金星二十年大运倾向的生活领域：关系、财务与物质、创造，每一项都是倾向而非定数。
